articleTitle: Automated control system for arduino and android based intelligent greenhouse
publicationTitle: 2015 XI International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: At work we present the structure of control system of Arduino microcontroller and Android device based greenhouse, describe features of developed software and physical model based on the Arduino microcontroller using Android device. The management system of Arduino and Android based greenhouse was implemented physically and tested, and is characterized by low price.

articleTitle: Elements of the formal model big date
publicationTitle: 2015 XI International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The article proposes and describes the elements of the generalized formal model of big data. It is analyzed the peculiarities of the application of the proposed model components.

articleTitle: Data management for distributive collaborative CAD system
publicationTitle: 2015 XI International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: This paper is devoted to reasoning about architectural model and data management approach for modern collaborative distributed CAD systems.

articleTitle: Car speed control with different types of controllers
publicationTitle: 2015 XI International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this paper there was considered the implementation of a build principle of the automatic control systems for electric car speed control. And there was comparison of the control system with different types of controllers with variable structure.

articleTitle: VHDL-AMS model of delta-sigma (ΔΣ) modulator for A/D converter in mems interface circuit
publicationTitle: 2015 XI International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In the paper, VHDL-AMS model of delta-sigma (ΔΣ) for MEMS A/D conversion circuits has been developed. The developed model allows to simulate the change of the impulses sequence at the output of the delta-sigma modulator depending on the input signal and also to conduct the analysis of the delta-sigma modulator at the block design level.

articleTitle: About the efficiency and costs ratio of the hearing screening of the newborns
publicationTitle: 2015 XI International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Screening program for the newborns is presented, which is based solely on the discovery of the formula for setting the norms of the middle ear and the principle of sound reflection from the tympanum; genetic connection between the sound "a" formants and both resonant frequencies of the middle ear; birth hearing defect, which is measured with much greater precision than the measurement precision of the "audiological zero" in the subjective audiometry; spectrum separation into integrating frequency groups (critical bands) exclusively in the cochlea of the inner human's ear; the fact that the formula for the middle ear norm parameter is constant, which unites both physical and geometrical parameters of the ear; the existence of the sound pressure receptors of on the tympanum; the mechanism of otoacoustic emissions. Unlike other national programs, it is based on the exact proportions of the law of formation and functioning of the auditory analyzer that eliminates the medical errors likelihood, and does not require highly skilled medical personnel.

Author Keywords: Resonant frequencies of the middle ear

articleTitle: Code control systems based on the combinatorial optimization
publicationTitle: 2015 XI International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: This paper presents regular method for improving the quality indices of 2D code control systems with respect to minimizing of redundancy and complicity of the systems based on the “perfect” combinatorial configurations prospected from 2D torus cyclic groups, namely the concept of 2D Ideal Ring Bundles (IRBs).

articleTitle: Application of new information technologies for the study of cell activity
publicationTitle: 2015 XI International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The current stage of medical science development leads to the elaboration and implementation of new information technologies. It acquires particular importance in the study of cells - the basis of any biological system. The offered approach to finding information on morphofunctional state of hormone producing cells is based on decomposition of their special activity on 4 components (synthesis, secretion, transport hormones, the energy supply of these processes), followed by the point assessment on a special scale of number and state of cell organelles that implement the corresponding direction. The object of the study is electron diffraction patterns of cells of the endocrine glands, including the thyroid gland, made by conventional methods. Further mathematical transformation of the obtained digital material allows characterizing specific activity of the studied cell, detecting deviations, developing approaches to their adjustment, and predicting the development of pathological processes.

articleTitle: Hardware implementation design of analog neural rank-order filter
publicationTitle: 2015 XI International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Hardware implementation design in FPGA based reconfigurable computing architecture of analog neural rank-order filter is presented. The problem of rank-order filtering is solved on the base of analog neural circuit which determines maximal value signals among signal set. The filter is described by system of algebra-differential equations and combines such properties as high accuracy and speed, low computational and hardware implementation complexity, and independency on initial conditions. The filter can be used for processing of constant signals, variable signals, and also equal signals. The filter simulation examples confirming theoretical statements are provided. According to simulation results, the neural rank-order filter implemented in hardware is capable to signal processing with much higher speed comparatively to its software implementation.

articleTitle: New possibilities of the tympanoplasty after the discovery of the formula for the middle ear norm parameter
publicationTitle: 2015 XI International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Different models of the human middle ear that may help to assess its condition before and after tympanoplasty are considered. In particular, a curved membrane is considered as a model of the eardrum. Separately, the Shrapnel's membrane and its role in the reduction of the eardrum are analyzed. As a model for the whole of the middle ear, a model based on electroacoustic analogies is selected. It made possible to obtain quantitative indicators of the human auditory system: the norm of the middle ear and the gain coefficient of the sound pressure made by auditory ossicles, and give recommendations on tympanoplasty materials selection and evaluating the success of its implementation.

Author Keywords: formula for the middle ear norm parameter

articleTitle: The concept of the embody reliability in design of cyber-physical systems
publicationTitle: 2015 XI International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The concept of creating of the embody reliability in design of cyber-physical systems, using novel techniques based on the combinatorial configurations, including two- and multidimensional Ideal Ring Bundles (IRB)s is developed. These design techniques make it possible to configure cyberphysical systems with fewer elements than at present, while maintaining or improving on resolving ability, structural redundancy and security of the system. Keywords - Reliability, Design, Cyber-physical system, Combinatorial optimization, Ideal Ring Bundle, Torus cyclic group, Monolithic code, Frame of reference, Code control system.

articleTitle: Repeatability the block cyclic structures the basis matrices of DCT for sizes pn
publicationTitle: 2015 XI International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The structures of basis matrices for efficient computation discrete cosine transforms (DCT) using cyclic convolutions for size the integer power of prime is considered. The structures of basis matrices of DCT are presented via the hashing arrays. Interconnection of the structures or hashing arrays of DCT for the sizes the integer power of prime are determined, what are simplified the analysis of the basis matrices on the stage of synthesis the fast algorithms.

articleTitle: Cells modeling approaches for microfluidic biodevices
publicationTitle: 2015 XI International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: in this paper concept of approach for the detection and measurement in the biomedical analisys device based on cells deflection is presented.

articleTitle: Analytical modeling of membrane bending in range of large deflections
publicationTitle: 2015 XI International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In early stage of the design process, modeling is a crucial phase as it allows the designer estimating the device performance. Very often, this phase is time-consuming, especially when FEM simulator is used. Hence, a fast and reliable method is desirable. Moreover, in case of simple structures which behavior is described with quite simple equations, the use of analytical model is obvious. In this paper we present a complete model of a membrane bending in range of large deflections that has been developed using FEM simulations.

articleTitle: Development of automation subsystem modeling using COMSOL API
publicationTitle: 2015 XI International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this paper describes the features of the design automation subsystem modeling using COMSOL API. They also analyzed the modern design of microelectromechanical systems devices described environment creating programs and implemented software solution. Developed subsystem allows you to automate model building and simulation exercises distribution of temperature, electric potential, and warp actuators.

articleTitle: Information technologies in nanotechnologies
publicationTitle: 2015 XI International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: This article describes possible choice and use of free shared nano-objekt modeling programs in nanotechnologies studying. Such programs as RasMol, QuteMol, Jmol, Jsmol, XMD, Gromacs.

articleTitle: Modeling of the design process MEM's products based on the process approach by ISO 9001
publicationTitle: 2015 XI International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The design process of complicated technical means as one of the phase of total product life cycle (LCP) has been analyzed. According to the recommendations to ISO 9001 standards design process is considered as a set of interrelated processes. The process divided into stages. Defined objective, criterias and specifications for each stage. Formalized model of the design process. The scheme of algorithm analysis and control process parameters has developed.

articleTitle: Mathematical simulation of deformational and relaxation process in capillary-porous materials
publicationTitle: 2015 XI International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Within mechanics of heterogeneous media there was developed a mathematical model of stress-deformable - state of wood as a three-phase system consisting of solid (wood material), liquid and air-vapor mixture phases. Defining relation allow to describe elastic, viscoelastic, residual strain deformations and deformations caused by mechanism of mechanical and sorption creep. The object-oriented software was created to implement the mathematical model of viscoelastic deformation of capillary-porous materials using the finite element method.

articleTitle: Statistical analysis of spectroscopy reflectance, absorption and transmission of light in the turbid planar layer
publicationTitle: 2015 XI International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this paper conducted a statistical study of the spectral characteristics of photons transportation in turbid plane parallel medium. There is developed Matlab code for modeling of photons transportation in turbid medium.

articleTitle: "Quantum" diagnosis and simulation of SoC
publicationTitle: 2015 XI International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Matrix method for diagnosing functional failures and stuck-at faults in software or hardware units is proposed. It is based on qubit or multi-valued data structures for defining diagnostic information, which allows significantly reducing the computational complexity of the simulation and diagnosis due to the introduction of parallel logical operations on the matrix data.

articleTitle: An approach to porting a PC application’s GUI to emwin-based firmware
publicationTitle: 2015 XI International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: This work shows a problem of updating firmware, in particular its GUI and states the need of developing a PC application for translating GUI code written in different languages to C code that uses emWin. Design of such an application-“translator” is given.

articleTitle: Computer-aided design of passenger traffic system
publicationTitle: 2015 XI International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The article deals with the peculiarities and problems of computer-aided design of the city passenger traffic system.

articleTitle: Formalization of context-free grammars by means of modified algebra of algorithms
publicationTitle: 2015 XI International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: We consider the use of the modified algebra of algorithms to formalize the grammars and derivations of context-free grammars. The inference rules and the derivations themselves of several applied grammars have been given by formulas of modified algebra of algorithms. We illustrate the use of operations of sequencing as well as operations of paralleling to describe the inference rules.

articleTitle: Investigation of remote lab design technologies
publicationTitle: 2015 XI International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this paper the features of remote laboratories development are given. Investigation of tools and embodiments of the remote laboratories software was done. The development technology was chosen and approved based on requirement analysis for remote labs'. The different approaches to the organization of remote labs management system were considered. The practical results of the remote lab implementation for embedded systems design are given.

articleTitle: Noise impact assessment on the accuracy of the determination of speaker’s gender by using method of the cumulant coefficients
publicationTitle: 2015 XI International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: A new method of classification of a speaker's gender based on cumulant coefficients is proposed. The effect of an additive noise and measurement error of classification signs on accuracy of classification is analyzed. The expediency of construction of an adaptive system of classification operating with considering of masking of a speech signal by noise is shown. Comparison of the proposed method of classification of the speaker's gender to competing methods shows that the proposed method provides better classification accuracy, resistant to the effects of noise interference and much simpler for technical implementation.

articleTitle: Texture image evaluation and searching by statistical size-intensity features
publicationTitle: 2015 XI International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this paper an extraction of intensity variance and size-intensity mean features is considered. Their effectiveness is compared for texture image searching.

articleTitle: Adapted methodology for design micro liquid system
publicationTitle: 2015 XI International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this paper presented adapted methodology for design micro fluidic system which includes the design features of micro fluidic system.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of simulation results and experimental data of deflection of silicon membrane of MEMS pressure sensor
publicationTitle: 2015 XI International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The article presented research results of stressed and strained state of sensitive element of MEMS sensor depending on the pressure applied. A code for the ANSYS system was developed allowing to automate the process of constructing a solid model of pressure sensor and stressed and deformed state, taking into account technological features of their production. As a result of the program processing one gets graphical dependencies in the plate of the sensor and it's maximum displacement depending on the pressure applied. Experimental study of sensitive element of pressure sensor was conducted, which enable to compare simulation results with experimentally obtained.

articleTitle: Design of the electric drive wheel mechanism with pneumatic accumulator in CATIA environment
publicationTitle: 2015 XI International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The approach to the design and development of the electric drive wheel mechanism with the engine braking force, that can be used by pneumatic accumulator for its elimination, is considered. It is substantiated that the new product will be energy-saving and will ensure gains in traction and braking force taking into consideration the customer's needs. CATIA was chosen as the most proper environment for the design as its libraries are the most suitable for machine-building.

articleTitle: Development of measurement subsystem for thermal characteristics composites research
publicationTitle: 2015 XI International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this paper, based on computing and information techniques, developed components and subsystem as a whole, which allows you to get the results of measuring temperature values in digital form for further processing in the system design of composite material.

articleTitle: Modeling and analysis of three-dimensional design of the mixer considering production technology
publicationTitle: 2015 XI International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In the paper the resuls of the research of output parameters of microfluidic T-mixer considering production technology is presented. The model is developed using the Comsol system and research conducted. The results allow to state that although the flow is laminar in the connection of two input streams there is only a slight perturbation flow that depends on the input speed of the liquid and its viscosity.

articleTitle: Informational model for microfluidic system
publicationTitle: 2015 XI International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: This paper presents an informational model for microfluidic systems.

articleTitle: Nanocomposites based on nanosilicon and silica aerogel powders for sensor applications
publicationTitle: 2015 XI International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Luminescent properties of heterogeneous composite systems based on nanosilicon nc-Si and silica aerogel matrix ar-SiOx have been investigated using photoluminescence spectroscopy method. The photoluminescence sensor response of composite structures at the presence of water molecules and ethyl alcohol solutions has been investigated.
